name: user_chooses_go_back_from_options
goal: User reviews employee details and chooses 'Go back', returning to the main menu.
constraints: Employee details must be present. User selects 'Go back' instead of proceeding.

phases.description: Bot displays employee details and options.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays correct employee details and options.
Bot ends task and displays main menu prompt with all listed options.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
